description: A MessagePack hub protocol for ASP.NET Core SignalR (server and .NET client) on the fast LsMsgPack serializer: "lsmsgpack" with LsMsgPack's values for its TypeScript client and .NET clients, or registered as "messagepack" with the bytes of Microsoft's MessagePack protocol for the existing clients.
MailKit implementation of ForEach.Email.Abstractions: AddMailKitEmail registers IEmailSender (SMTP with STARTTLS or plain, optional login) and IEmlBuilder (.eml rendering with MimeKit).

IEmailSender and IEmlBuilder: the vendor-neutral contracts for sending one HTML e-mail and for rendering the same message as a downloadable .eml file. No dependencies, so an application layer can reference it without pulling in a mail library.
